question: In the classic 1988 Tim Burton film 'Beetlejuice,' there is a memorable scene set in an afterlife waiting room. A green-skinned receptionist, wearing a 'MISS ARGENTINA' sash, tiredly reflects on her 'little accident' while assisting the two recently deceased protagonists, Adam and Barbara. While a brief role, the character is played by an actress who also appeared in a famous 1986 comedy. Please identify: (1) The actress who portrays Miss Argentina, (2) The 1986 film in which this actress played a Mexican villager who recruits three out-of-work silent film actors, and (3) The name of the fictional Mexican village in that 1986 film as it appears in the movie, noting any grammatical peculiarities about its name.
answer: (1) The actress is Patrice Martinez. (2) She played Carmen in the 1986 film 'Three Amigos!' (also styled '¡Three Amigos!'). (3) The fictional Mexican village is named 'Santa Poco' as it appears in the movie. Grammatical note: 'Santa Poco' is grammatically incorrect in Spanish since 'santa' is feminine and 'poco' is masculine; the proper form would be 'Santo Poco', though 'San Poco' would be the conventional form in Mexican Spanish.
